limitations.quote: +    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
limitations.note: The patch clocked the rotation of `q` but left `data` combinational, so it showed the newly rotated bit instead of registering the pre-edge bit and ran one cycle ahead of the required sequence.
The test expected phase 1 on the first rising edge after reset release, so it passed the combinational output and would reject the correctly registered output, which starts at phase 0 on that edge.
